title: Vista Helicopter Tours of Chicago

services.name: Helicopter tour
services.desc: Make your proposal unforgettable with our exclusive "Marry Me" Helicopter Tour over Chicago. This private 35-minute flight includes stunning skyline views, romantic extras, and a bold “MARRY ME?” marquee sign visible from the sky. Whether it's at sunset, under the stars, or just above the city’s lights, our team will help you plan the perfect moment. Includes champagne, chocolates, red carpet, photo time, and a once-in-alifetime setting. “The customer service at Helicopter Tours was top-notch. They made us feel safe and well taken care of.” - Clyde Singletrary “I can’t recommend Helicopter Tours enough. A truly unique way to experience the beauty.” -Ashley
